svg.title: ipm — the intelligent package manager for Claude Code
svg.desc: Four items picked from two GitHub repos — a skill, an agent and a command from wshobson/agents, and the stripe plugin from anthropics/claude-plugins-official — each pinned to a commit, built by ipm install into one Claude Code plugin, .ipm/plugins/csharp-sdlc, that passes claude plugin validate --strict.

g.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.text: // INTELLIGENT PACKAGE MANAGER / FOR CLAUDE CODE
Pick skills, agents and commands from any repo.
Get one Claude Code plugin, pinned to commits.
